plugin.name: The Matrix: Path of Neo Fusion Fix
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window, or a borderless window covering the monitor. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the window. Needs a restart.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto puts the HUD in the screen corners. A ratio such as 4:3 or 16:9 keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Menus keep their 4:3 layout. Applies immediately.
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the bars above and below cutscenes on screens narrower than 16:9; Pillarbox keeps the 16:9 picture between side bars on wider screens; Both does both and always shows the original framing; Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Cutscenes and scripted cameras are not changed. The horizontal field of view is limited to 150 degrees. Applies immediately.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the copyright screen at start-up. Needs a restart.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game pauses while another window is active. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't slip onto another monitor. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game's menus. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
ResX.description: Width in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Needs a restart.
ResY.description: Height in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Needs a restart.
TextLanguage.description: Language of the fix's own texts. Auto follows the Windows display language.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted in order to apply settings.
